bio.text: Austin Rogers is the Republican candidate for Florida's 2nd Congressional District in 2026; WFSU reports he won an eight-person Republican primary.
According to his campaign website, he is a Panama City native and attorney who served as General Counsel to U.S. Senator Rick Scott, and earned his law degree from Duke University.
The site says he lives in Panama City with his wife Hala, a dermatologist, and their three children.

sources.title: Green wins the Democrat nod and advances to November for CD2
